catalogs.name: Beautiful UI
catalogs.take: Loading, empty, skeleton-to-content, filter chips that reorganize a table, insight cards with a scrubber. Choreography of states, not the agent-chat shell.
catalogs.refuse: Prompt bar, tool chips, approval cards, agent screen, chat panel on a listing or place page.

catalogs.name: beUI
catalogs.take: Tabs with a sliding indicator; expandable control for a grouped ask; action-swap for Tour/Call/Text; bottom sheet; drawer; accordion height; tooltip. Restyle to navy-on-cream, our motion bands, reduced-motion safe.
catalogs.refuse: Tilt cards, docks, magnetic/metallic buttons, shader backgrounds, cylinder carousel, marquee, gooey popover, bounce sidebar.

catalogs.name: Rare UI
catalogs.take: Scroll-progress on a long listing. Nothing else unless the job matches and the motion is in-band.
catalogs.refuse: Fluid orb, matrix orb, gravity letters, gooey nav, emoji reaction, bounce sidebar, GitHub activity, OTP.

catalogs.name: Transitions.dev
catalogs.take: Named recipes at our motion bands: panel reveal, modal open/close, tabs sliding, accordion height, skeleton-to-content, tooltip, image-open (camera only, no 3D glare).
catalogs.refuse: Confetti, gooey plus-menu, 3D tilt, like-button particles, spinning counters as decoration.

catalogs.name: shadcn/ui
catalogs.take: The full component list. Fetch the docs page for a named component, then the local file if we already installed it. Adapt composition (carousel, sheet, button group, dialog, tabs, accordion, empty, skeleton) into v3 on public pages. Install into components/ui only for admin/product.
catalogs.refuse: Copying shadcn's default look onto a listing page. Public paint is v3 tokens.

catalogs.name: Ryan Realty v3 barrel
catalogs.take: The public foundation. Fetch the actual TSX/CSS of the primitive that already does the job.
catalogs.refuse: A second primitive for a job one already does.
